description: This file is an HTML document implementing the front-end user interface for a Database Viewer application, with embedded CSS styles and JavaScript code to interact with the backend API for listing databases, tables, and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar list.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases on user request.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing database entries and loading their respective tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the list of tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and displays it in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for displaying table data, including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on data type, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long strings or JSON objects.
